input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，Ancient times are already a time expression, so adding 的时候 is redundant. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，医 cannot normally stand alone as the job noun after 当上; 医生 means “doctor.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，The verb 看 means “look”; when Shen Nong sees someone, the resultative complement 到 is needed. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers collectively to other people; 别的 needs a following noun to distinguish another kind of thing. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：任何病人吃了都会觉得身体更好，什么 is an interrogative word asking which patient, while 任何 expresses that all patients are included; 了 marks eating as completed before the resulting feeling. [rule: none]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is the appropriate measure word for an individual plant. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药：但是，他有一个问题，不知道什么东西能做药，After the subject has appeared in the same sentence and no other person competes with it, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：神农走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，Both the three-month walk and the discovery are completed past events, so they need 了; 走了三个月 expresses a completed duration naturally. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
医 cannot serve as the occupation noun here; 医生 is required.
The intended meaning is 'upon seeing,' which requires 看到, but 一看到 alone is an unfinished 一…就… structure in the shown correction.
别人 is a correct way to refer collectively to people other than Shen Nong, unlike the intended use of 别的人 here.
任何病人 correctly expresses the universal group, and 吃了 marks the eating as preceding the resulting feeling.
个 is an acceptable general measure word for 植物, although 株 is more specific.
Repeating 他 at the start of a new clause is natural and does not violate the teacher's same-clause zero-reference rule.
走了三个月 gives the duration in the correct order, and 找到了 appropriately marks the final completed event.
